base: Paths below are relative to the Atlas site root, one directory above this file.

operations.name: discover
operations.description: Release identity, capabilities, counts, worlds and scaling controls.

operations.name: search
operations.description: Search instrument contracts by query, world and status.

operations.name: describe
operations.description: Inputs, outputs, units, domains and verifier references from the manifest.

operations.name: forecast
operations.description: Conditional scaling scenarios. No empirical confidence or intervention domain guarantee.

operations.name: audit
operations.description: Chronological holdout metrics, baseline skill, interval scoring, horizon groups and replayable SHA-256 input.

operations.name: geometry_evidence
operations.description: Explicit FLRW/CPL geometry, DESI covariance, supplied reconstruction null test, round S3 scalar modes and reference lensing. No fitted posterior or topology detection.

operations.name: measure_s3
operations.description: Conditional round spatial S3 geodesic distance for two native R4 points, with explicit radius and unit.

operations.name: live_navigation
operations.description: Opt-in bridge to the existing HCC_API/HCC_NAV page interfaces; no public HTTP mutation endpoint.

evidence_policy: Synthetic validation does not establish empirical accuracy.
Supplied timestamps are declarations, not proof of prior registration.
Unknown values remain null; refused requests produce no plausible replacement result.
